Default: 64 (min 10, hard max 1048576). Soft warning above 4096. Used as the only cap in Fixed, or pass-1 base in Adaptive.
Default: 40 (min 10, hard max 1048576). Soft warning above 4096.
Default: 18 (range 1–31). Each round may double the iteration limit on border pixels.
Default: 262144 (min 10, hard max 1073741824). Soft warning above 4096. Ceiling across adaptive rounds.

Fixed mode uses the same max iterations at every zoom (default 64).

Scale with zoom starts at the base value at the home view (default base 40, multiplier 1.2). Each doubling of zoom multiplies max iterations by the multiplier. Values are clamped between 10 and 1048576; the UI warns if you enter more than 4096.

Adaptive mode renders pass 1 at the Fixed max, then only re-tests interior border pixels (next to escaped neighbors). At each doubled limit it keeps filling the border until a full pass finds no new escapes, then doubles again (or stops if that first pass found nothing). Intermediate border fills are shown on screen. The status overlay Iter line shows the max from the last border round; zoom does not raise pass-1 from that value.

Use Reset to defaults on this screen to restore factory iteration values; changing formula or HUD Reset does not change your iteration settings.
Values above 4096 can be very slow on deep zooms. Saved anyway.

Navigating the fractal

• Pan — drag with one finger. A live preview follows your finger; the full render finishes after you lift.

• Pinch zoom — use two fingers. Zoom stays anchored on the midpoint between your fingers. The zoom commits when you lift the last finger.

• Double-tap — zoom in on the tapped point.

• Long-press — show complex coordinates under your finger; lift to dismiss.

Bottom bar (HUD)

• + / − — zoom in or out about the screen center.
• Reset — return to the initial viewport.
• Export — share or save the current viewport as PNG.
• ☰ Menu — formula, random explore, palette, smooth, iterations, formula parameters (Julia/Phoenix), help, and about.

Random explore

Menu → Random explore finds a Mandelbrot detail without using a fixed coordinate catalog. It scans a low-resolution grid for points where interior and escaping samples meet, weights busy boundaries more heavily, then recenters and zooms. It repeats 3 to 12 times before rendering the result. Random explore switches to Mandelbrot Set but keeps your palette, smooth setting, and iteration settings.

Iterations

Menu → Iterations chooses Fixed max (default 64), Scale with zoom (base 40, multiplier 1.2), or Adaptive border refine (pass-1 at Fixed max, rounds default 18, cap default 262144). Reset to defaults on that screen restores factory values; changing formula or HUD Reset keeps your iteration settings.

Status overlay

The top-left panel shows the current formula, palette, smooth setting, iteration algorithm, and effective iteration cap. Tap to hide; tap ··· to show again.

Render progress

After you lift your finger, a thin bar at the top fills while the fractal re-renders (steps 8→4→2→1). In Adaptive mode, after step 1 the bar switches to an indeterminate animation while border refine runs. It hides when the frame is ready or when a new gesture starts.

Export

HUD Export → Share or Save to gallery. Captures the fractal view only.

Privacy

No network, ads, or analytics. Everything runs on your device.
